Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Strict Specification Compliance:

All products supplied must strictly match the technical specifications ( e.g., Handwash 250ml, Sanitizer 500ml, Detergent 1kg, Yoga Mat 6ftx 2ft with 6mm thickness, Electric Kettle 2Ltr, etc.) as detailed in the bid list. No deviation in item capacity, size, thickness, weight, or material qual ity will be accepted under any circumstances. 2. Exact Quantity Verification: The seller must supply the exact quantity as mentioned in the supply order. Incomplete deliveries, short-supplies, or unauthorized partial s hipments will result in the rejection of the entire lot until the total qua ntity is fully met. 3. Standard & Premium Quality Assurance: While specific OEM brands are not mandatory, all items must be of st andard commercial grade and premium quality. Substandard, look-ali ke generic items of poor material, or old stock will be rejected summa rily at the vendor's cost. 4. Secure and Factory-Sealed Packaging: All liquid, cleaning, and hygiene items (such as handwash, sanitizer, c ar wash, and room fresheners) must be delivered in their original, fact ory-sealed, and leak-proof packaging. Open, refilled, or tampered con tainers will be rejected instantly. 5. Physical Inspection and Right to Reject: The buyer reserves the right to conduct a thorough physical verificati on of the specifications and quantity at the time of delivery. Any item found non-compliant with the bid requirements must be replaced by t he vendor within 7 days at their own expense. . 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre.
